# Error reference

Every error below was produced by calling the server's own handler, on both surfaces, when this page was
generated; CI regenerates it and fails if a status, a message or an envelope has changed. A client should
branch on the **status** (and, on `/api/v1`, the `code`), never on the message text.

## The two shapes

| | `/api/…` (legacy) | `/api/v1/…` |
|---|---|---|
| Bad parameter | `400`, `{"error": "invalid request: <message>"}` | `400`, `{"error": {"code": "invalid_request", "message", "request_id"}}` |
| Not found (a gap, an unknown bani) | `404`, `{"error": "<message>"}` | `404`, code `not_found` |
| Unknown endpoint | `400`, `{"error": "invalid request: unknown endpoint"}` | `404`, code `not_found` |
| Unexpected failure | `500`, `{"error": "internal server error"}` | `500`, code `internal`, message `internal server error` |

The legacy shape is frozen: the golden contract and the app depend on it byte for byte. New clients should
use `/api/v1`, whose `request_id` is the same id as the `X-Request-Id` header and the access log
([versioning and caching](versioning-and-caching.md)). A `500` never carries the exception; the detail is
only in the server log, under that request id.

## Every error, as the server answers it

| Request | When | Status | Legacy body | `/api/v1` code · message |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `/api/nope` | a path that is not a route | 400 · v1 404 | `{"error": "invalid request: unknown endpoint"}` | `not_found` · no such endpoint: /api/v1/nope |
| `/api/ang` | a route that needs an id, without one | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: /api/ang requires an id"}` | `invalid_request` · /api/ang requires an id |
| `/api/ang/abc` | an id that is not an integer | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: integer parameter expected"}` | `invalid_request` · integer parameter expected |
| `/api/ang/1234567890123` | an integer longer than 12 characters | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: integer parameter too long"}` | `invalid_request` · integer parameter too long |
| `/api/search?q=naam&limit=abc` | an integer parameter that is not an integer | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: integer parameter expected"}` | `invalid_request` · integer parameter expected |
| `/api/shabad/1` | a `comp_id` that is a permanent gap | 404 | `{"error": "no composition with comp_id 1"}` | `not_found` · no composition with comp_id 1 |
| `/api/shabad/99999999` | a `comp_id` beyond the last composition | 404 | `{"error": "no composition with comp_id 99999999"}` | `not_found` · no composition with comp_id 99999999 |
| `/api/search?q=‹301 characters›` | a search query over 300 characters | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: query too long (max 300 chars)"}` | `invalid_request` · query too long (max 300 chars) |
| `/api/verify?q=` | an empty claim | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: empty claim"}` | `invalid_request` · empty claim |
| `/api/verify?q=‹601 characters›` | a claim over 600 characters | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: claim too long (max 600 chars)"}` | `invalid_request` · claim too long (max 600 chars) |
| `/api/bani` | a bani without its key | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: /api/bani requires a key"}` | `invalid_request` · /api/bani requires a key |
| `/api/bani/NOPE!` | a key with characters a key never has | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: bad bani key"}` | `invalid_request` · bad bani key |
| `/api/bani/nope` | a well-formed key that is not a bani | 404 | `{"error": "no bani with key nope"}` | `not_found` · no bani with key nope |
| `/api/bani/japji?variant=zz` | a variant that is not one of the bani's | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: bad variant"}` | `invalid_request` · bad variant |
| `/api/analytics/progression` | progression without `raag` | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: progression requires a raag"}` | `invalid_request` · progression requires a raag |
| `/api/timing/raag` | a raag lookup without `name` | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: timing/raag requires ?name="}` | `invalid_request` · timing/raag requires ?name= |
| `/api/forms?comp_id=0` | forms without a usable `comp_id` | 400 | `{"error": "invalid request: forms requires ?comp_id="}` | `invalid_request` · forms requires ?comp_id= |

## Not errors

Most parameters are clamped to their range rather than rejected, and some malformed input simply finds
nothing. These requests all return `200`; check the body, not only the status:

| Request | What happens | Status | Body (lists shown as their length, Gurmukhi as ‹Gurmukhi›) |
|---|---|--:|---|
| `/api/ang/0` | an Ang below 1 is clamped to 1 | 200 | `{"ang": 1, "lines": [23 items], "continued_from": null, "raag": null, "section": ‹Gurmukhi›, "authors": [0 items]}` |
| `/api/ang/1431` | an Ang above 1430 is clamped to 1430 | 200 | `{"ang": 1430, "lines": [57 items], "continued_from": 1429, "raag": null, "section": ‹Gurmukhi›, "authors": [1 item]}` |
| `/api/search?q=naam&limit=999` | `limit` above 200 is clamped to 200 | 200 | `{"mode": "theme", "concept": {…}, "results": [200 items], "related_themes": [0 items]}` |
| `/api/lines?ids=abc` | ids that are not digits are ignored | 200 | `{"lines": [0 items], "note": "verbatim Gurmukhi by line id, cited by Ang"}` |
| `/api/analytics/vaar?id=x` | a Vaar id that is not a number finds no Vaar | 200 | `{"vaar": null, "units": [0 items]}` |
| `/api/word` | no word: nothing to count | 200 | `{"word": "", "count": 0, "lines": [0 items]}` |
| `/api/neighbors` | no `line_id`: no neighbours | 200 | `{"line_id": 0, "level": "none", "neighbors": [0 items]}` |
| `/api/timing/raag?name=nope` | an unknown raag name: no claims | 200 | `{"available": true, "raag": "nope", "claims": [0 items], "note": "no such raag"}` |

## Beyond a single request

- **`404` from a single-context service.** A service that runs one context answers a route it does not
  own with `404` and the message `/api/<route> is not served by this service`. Through the public origin
  the gateway always sends a route to its own service, so a client only sees this when calling a function
  directly ([bounded contexts and the gateway](../architecture/bounded-contexts-and-gateway.md)).
- **`503` from `/readyz`.** `{"ready": false, …}` when a declared table is missing, or
  `{"ready": false, "error": "database unavailable"}`. `/healthz` is liveness only.
- **The platform in front.** Vercel may answer before the API does, for example a timeout or a challenge
  page for an unusual burst of requests. Such responses are not JSON from this API and carry no
  `X-Service` header.
